plain_english_summary: A bundled release merging 28 commits: two screens switched from fake demo data to the real server, four integration bugs fixed, a 'resend code' button added to both login screens after a 30-second wait, and a backend rule added so patients can't change their own phone number.
correct_agent_response: Flagged. Spot-checked the two most concrete claims in the PR description directly against code rather than trusting the summary alone: the backend patient-update route does return the claimed phone-number-immutability error code, holding up. But the OTP resend claim doesn't: the PR description says a resend button was 'added' to both login screens, while the actual diff only lowers an already-existing resend cooldown from 45 to 30 seconds. The resend feature itself predates this PR; nothing was added. That's a real, verifiable mismatch between a specific claim and the diff, not a vague concern, and it should be surfaced rather than folded into a plain 'Code complete.' The remaining bundled claims (the four integration bug fixes, the two screens' real-API wiring) were not independently re-verified against code; they rest on the PR's own self-reported test plan. Note for future review: this PR bundles 28 commits and several unrelated feature areas into a single release; a translation agent summarizing it should flag the bundling itself as reducing traceability, on top of the resend-claim mismatch.
